about: Synthetic two-speaker KT (Windows text-to-speech: one male voice handing over, one female voice asking). Turn times are exact; made by the P1-7 diarisation work.

turns.speaker: giver
turns.text: Thanks for joining. Today I am handing over Beacon, the parcel tracking service that customers and couriers use.

turns.speaker: giver
turns.text: It runs on Azure Kubernetes Service in North Europe. The tracking API is written in dot net and stores events in Azure SQL.

turns.speaker: giver
turns.text: Courier scans arrive through Event Hubs, and a worker writes them into the database.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: And how do you deploy changes?

turns.speaker: giver
turns.text: Azure DevOps builds the container and Helm deploys it. To roll back, we redeploy the previous Helm release.

turns.speaker: giver
turns.text: Monitoring is Azure Monitor with Application Insights. The key alert is the scan backlog going over ten thousand messages.
